mapper.select: SELECT r.app_role_id, r.company_id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_type, r.description, r.use_yn, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_role_permission rp WHERE rp.app_role_id = r.app_role_id AND rp.active_yn = 'Y' ) AS permission_count, 'N' AS assigned_yn FROM app_role r WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} AND r.app_role_id = #{roleId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_role WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND ( LOWER(TRIM(role_code)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{roleCode})) OR LOWER(TRIM(role_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(#{roleName})) )
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO app_role ( company_id, role_code, role_name, role_type, description, use_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( #{companyId}, #{roleCode}, #{roleName}, #{roleType}, #{description}, #{useYn}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.app_permission_id, p.permission_code, p.permission_name, p.description, CASE WHEN r.role_type = 'OWNER' THEN 'Y' WHEN rp.active_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS assigned_yn FROM app_role r CROSS JOIN app_permission p LEFT JOIN app_role_permission rp ON rp.app_role_id = r.app_role_id AND rp.app_permission_id = p.app_permission_id WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} AND r.app_role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.permission_code ASC
SELECT app_permission_id, permission_code, permission_name, description, 'N' AS assigned_yn FROM app_permission ORDER BY permission_code ASC

mapper.update: MERGE INTO app_role_permission target USING ( SELECT #{roleId} AS app_role_id, #{permissionId} AS app_permission_id FROM dual ) source ON ( target.app_role_id = source.app_role_id AND target.app_permission_id = source.app_permission_id ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.active_yn = 'Y', target.updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), target.updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( app_role_id, app_permission_id, active_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( source.app_role_id, source.app_permission_id, 'Y', #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy} )
mapper.select: SELECT r.app_role_id, r.company_id, r.role_code, r.role_name, r.role_type, r.description, r.use_yn, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM app_role_permission rp WHERE rp.app_role_id = r.app_role_id AND rp.active_yn = 'Y' ) AS permission_count, CASE WHEN ur.active_yn = 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS assigned_yn FROM app_role r LEFT JOIN app_user_role ur ON ur.app_role_id = r.app_role_id AND ur.app_user_id = #{userId} WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} AND r.role_type = 'CUSTOM' AND r.use_yn = 'Y' ORDER BY r.role_name ASC

mapper.update: UPDATE app_user_role SET active_yn = 'N', updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHERE app_user_id = #{userId} AND active_yn = 'Y' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM app_role r WHERE r.app_role_id = app_user_role.app_role_id AND r.company_id = #{companyId} AND r.role_type = 'CUSTOM' )

MERGE INTO app_user_role target USING ( SELECT #{userId} AS app_user_id, #{roleId} AS app_role_id FROM dual ) source ON ( target.app_user_id = source.app_user_id AND target.app_role_id = source.app_role_id ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.active_yn = 'Y', target.updated_at = CAST( SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP ), target.updated_by = #{updatedBy} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( app_user_id, app_role_id, active_yn, created_by, updated_by ) VALUES ( source.app_user_id, source.app_role_id, 'Y', #{updatedBy}, #{updatedBy} )
